gaps.title: Checkpoint saver is in-memory only
gaps.description: AgentRuntime uses MemorySaver. Process restart loses all agent state. SqliteSaver from langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite is available but not wired.
gaps.impact: Cannot survive process restart without external state serialization.
gaps.mitigation: sqlite3 checkpoint adapter planned for future phase.
gaps.tests: tests/recovery/test_recovery.py verifies event persistence survives restart.

gaps.title: HITL session store is in-memory only
gaps.description: Paused sessions in api.py _paused_sessions dict are lost on process restart.
gaps.impact: Pending approvals are lost if the API process restarts.
gaps.mitigation: Sessions should be persisted to SqliteEventStore.

gaps.title: No notification mechanism for HITL
gaps.description: When a tool call requires approval, the API returns 202 but there is no push notification, webhook, or CLI prompt.
gaps.impact: Human operator must poll or check logs to discover pending approvals.
gaps.mitigation: Acceptable for reference implementation; production would add webhooks.

gaps.title: Starlette TestClient httpx deprecation
gaps.description: starlette.testclient uses httpx; httpx2 is recommended. This is an upstream deprecation in the starlette/fastapi ecosystem.
gaps.impact: Deprecation warning in test output. No functional impact.
gaps.mitigation: Will resolve when fastapi updates its test client dependency.

gaps.title: LangGraph serializer allowed_objects default warning
gaps.description: LangGraph's JsonPlusSerializer will change the default for allowed_objects. Current default behavior is preserved but emits a warning.
gaps.impact: Pending deprecation. No functional change yet.
gaps.mitigation: Suppress via filterwarnings in pyproject.toml or update when LangGraph releases the change.

gaps.title: No official tau2-bench evaluation executed
gaps.description: Phase 5 infrastructure is ready but no real benchmark has been run. This is by design — official evaluation must be manual outside Claude Code.
gaps.impact: Performance against the benchmark is unknown.
gaps.mitigation: Human operator must run scripts/run_benchmark.py and evaluate manually.

gaps.title: MockLLM and StubMCPClient in production source
gaps.description: Test fakes live in src/fxfill_banking_agent/ alongside production code. They are never imported by the production path but co-location is a code organization issue.
gaps.impact: Production code and test fakes share a module. No runtime risk.
gaps.mitigation: Move to tests/conftest.py or a testing subpackage in a future cleanup.
gaps.tests: All tests import from production source; no runtime impact.
